extra.reason: Added visibility to CreateSessionRequest/UpdateSessionRequest (now required on both), wired through to domain SetVisibility/NewSession, and removed the standalone-must-be-public restriction so standalone sessions can be public or private.
Removed hardcoded GATEWAY_API_KEY from observability/prometheus.yml; switched to credentials_file backed by a Docker Compose secret, rotated the key in .env

Added a transaction-scoped Postgres advisory lock (lockSessionCapacity) before each capacity check/write in CreateRSVP, UpdateRSVP, and ApproveAttendee, closing the check-then-act race. Verified with a concurrency integration test that fails without the lock and passes with it.

Made NewRSVPManualAttendee check capacity itself for status=Going (downgrading to Pending + emitting AutoPendingEvent when full) instead of relying on a follow-up UpdateRSVP call that was always a no-op since newStatus already equaled the just-constructed status. Verified with unit tests that fail without the fix.

ReconstructActivityGroup was silently dropping its capacity parameter instead of assigning it to the struct, so GetActivityGroupByID always returned nil DefaultCapacity and group capacity was never enforced regardless of concurrency. Fixed by assigning capacity: capacity in the struct literal; verified via a debug test that round-trips a group through create+load.

Added lockGroupCapacity (transaction-scoped Postgres advisory lock, distinct namespace from the session lock) before the capacity check in RequestToJoin and ApproveMember, mirroring the b48 fix for session attendees. Verified with a concurrency integration test (20 attempts of concurrent ApproveMember against a capacity-1 group); also required fixing rekreativko-api-ypt since the capacity check was otherwise unconditionally skipped.
